headline: Lattice Semiconductor, Allegro MicroSystems, Monolithic Power Systems, Marvell Technology, and MACOM Shares Are Falling, What You Need To Know
summary: A number of stocks fell in the morning session after the U.S. government announced new tariffs of 10% to 12.5% on 60 trading partners over concerns related to forced labor. The targeted nations include the European Union, Japan, South Korea, and Taiwan—the fundamental pillars of the global semiconductor supply chain.
